summary: Implemented a standard-library OOXML workbook adapter, normalization and deterministic import CLI for the seven business sheets. The CLI computes measured counts from source rows and writes only the declared BATCH-05 import artifacts.

external_gate_receipts.governance_note: The dispatch and archived receipt mark the gate ACCEPTED. The external-gate registry text in the supplied root plan and batches.json still says MISSING; this static registry discrepancy is preserved as a remaining risk rather than silently rewritten.

changed_files.purpose: Raw OOXML cell reader preserving sheet, row, coordinate, XML type, value and formula metadata.
Canonical fields, null and +08:00 time normalization, ID/association validation, counts and redacted provenance.
Deterministic read-only import CLI and declared JSON artifacts.
Real-sheet coordinate/type and long-ID source-cell tests.
Real counts, determinism, input-byte protection and controlled malformed-workbook tests.

dependency_changes.reason: Standard-library zipfile and xml.etree parsing made an Excel dependency unnecessary.

acceptance_results.criterion: Actual workbook produces 138 conversations, 998 messages, 113 orders, 29 image messages, 80 tickets, and 24/13/15/10/18 ticket-sheet counts.
Long IDs remain character-for-character strings; numeric long IDs, blank primary IDs and invalid associations are detected without float-to-string repair.
Counts are derived from source rows, row deletion/addition changes a count, repeated imports are deterministic, and the original workbook bytes remain unchanged.
The implementation uses the required direct-child isolated venv, leaves the lock unchanged, and passes pip check.

remaining_risks: The static X-A-MAPPING entries in the supplied root MASTER_PLAN.md and batches.json still state MISSING, while the dispatched package and archive report state ACCEPTED. This implementation consumed the archived accepted blob without editing governance files; the coordinator should reconcile the registry before scheduling a dependent batch.
risks: Three source payment-time cells carry a preserved （定金） annotation after the timestamp. The normalized time uses the exact timestamp prefix at +08:00 and retains the annotation in-memory/provenance rather than discarding it.
